 "More Than a Sci-Fi": Tom Hardy & Cillian Murphy's "Mind-Bending" Heist Drama is on Netflix Now 
 This sci-fi heist thriller is a twisty masterpiece and a must-see 
 By Josh Osman Published: 12 November 2026 Save Article Mark Sullivan Christopher Nolan has his favourites. And by that, I mean that there are a handful of actors he'll work with over and over again until the day he stops making films. Two of them are Tom Hardy and Cillian Murphy, and to be honest, we're grateful for that, especially since the pair have been on screen together in the likes of Dunkirk and Peaky Blinders . But we can't forget about the film that started it all.
 Inception is often viewed as Nolan's best work, and it was the first time that Hardy and Murphy were on screen together, alongside the rest of the absolutely star-studded cast. Best of all, it's available to stream now, so if you're yet to see it or dying to rewatch it to see if you can crack that mind-bending ending, you can just hop onto Netflix.
 What is Inception about?
 What a good question. It's hard to say, really. Inception follows a professional thief who infiltrates the minds of his victims to steal information from their subconscious. Then he's presented with a job (and an offer) that could change the course of his career. To give anything else away would be a true injustice to the film's twisty nature.
 Who is in the cast of Inception ?
 The film features a large ensemble cast led by Leonardo DiCaprio, with Ken Watanabe, Marion Cotillard, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page, Tom Hardy, Cillian Murphy, Dileep Rao, Tom Berenger and Michael Caine in supporting roles.
 What have critics said about Inception ?
 Inception opened to highly positive reviews from critics, who praised its twisty and cerebral narrative and judged it to be so much more than a simple sci-fi blockbuster flick. It currently has an 86% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, where the critical consensus reads: "Smart, innovative, and thrilling, Inception is that rare summer blockbuster that succeeds viscerally as well as intellectually."
 Tom Charity of CNN called it "a spectacular fantasy thriller based on Nolan's own original screenplay, Inception is the smartest CGI head-trip since The Matrix ." Meanwhile, Kate Muir of The Times wrote: " Inception is a grown-up thriller ride through the dreamscapes of the mind, with Leonardo DiCaprio in the lead. The movie is a sign that Hollywood retains some intellectual oomph."
 Where can I watch Inception ?
 Inception is available to stream on Netflix, Prime Video and HBO Max.
